title: Preserve sequential ranking groups across evaluation batches
head: 8325924934e574c081031cf8be91bfe24f5a720c
body:
### Description

Sequential evaluation reshapes each inference batch into ranking groups. A valid file containing one positive and four negatives per group therefore fails with batch sizes such as 8 or 32, because a group crosses the batch boundary. The same error interrupts validation inside `fit`.

Collect predictions and labels in file order, then form the ranking groups once all batches are available. This keeps group membership independent of the inference batch size. Aligned-batch metrics remain unchanged, and incomplete input files still raise instead of silently discarding rows.

Fixes #2462.

### Validation

[Independent validation](https://github.com/Afloat16/recommenders/actions/runs/43895839192) checks exact head `8325924934e574c081031cf8be91bfe24f5a720c` on Python 3.10/PyTorch 2.0.1 and Python 3.11/PyTorch 2.5.1:

- Unchanged SLi-Rec suite: **12 passed**.
- New cases on unchanged staging: **13 failed, 9 passing controls**.
- Patched model suite: **34 passed** in both environments.
- Native file evaluation covers one, two and four negatives per group and batch sizes 1, 3, 8, 16, 32 and 100. All seven reported metrics match the single-batch reference.
- Two integration cases perform real training and parameter updates, then validate with unaligned training batch sizes.
- Additional cases cover whole-group history filtering and rejection of a truncated final group.
- Black and `git diff --check` pass. Local Python 3.12.14/PyTorch 2.5.1 gives the same results.

### History review

Checked 1,497 upstream PR heads and 69 existing fork branches, including all four reachable PyTorch sequential-base versions under both current and former filenames and all 20 historical TensorFlow sequential-base-model versions. These variants all reshape ranking groups within each batch; intermediate commits and former paths are included.

### Checklist

- [x] Contribution guidelines and code style followed.
- [x] Regressions added to the existing registered SLi-Rec test module.
- [x] The evaluation docstring describes cross-batch groups.
- [x] Commit includes the required `Signed-off-by` trailer.
- [x] Targets `staging`.
